canonical_statement: The study aimed to assess the effectiveness and safety of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists in patients with ATTR-CM receiving disease-modifying therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We aimed to assess the effectiveness and safety of MRAs in patients with ATTR-CM receiving disease-modifying therapy.

canonical_statement: This was a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX US database, which the article describes as comprising more than 124 million individuals from 71 US healthcare organisations.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We conducted this retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX US database ... comprising over 124 million individuals from 71 healthcare organisations (HCO) in the USA

canonical_statement: Eligible patients were adults who received their first tafamidis or vutrisiran prescription within 1 year after incident heart failure diagnosis between 1 September 2019 and 10 December 2025.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We accessed adult patients who received their first prescription of tafamidis or vutrisiran within 1 year after their incident HF diagnosis between 1 September 2019 ... and 10 December 2025.

population.label: Adults with ATTR-CM starting tafamidis or vutrisiran within 1 year of incident HF
inclusion_criteria: First tafamidis or vutrisiran prescription within 1 year after incident HF diagnosis

canonical_statement: Patients were excluded for eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, hyperkalaemia with serum potassium at least 5.5 mEq/L, end-stage renal disease/dialysis, or NT-proBNP at least 10,000 pg/mL before tafamidis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We excluded patients with contraindications of using MRA before tafamidis, including an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of less than 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, hyperkalaemia (serum potassium >=5.5 mEq/L) or end-stage renal disease/dialysis. Patients with a serum N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide ... >=10 000 pg/mL were also excluded

canonical_statement: MRA users were defined as patients with at least two prescription records for spironolactone or eplerenone within 1 year before tafamidis or vutrisiran initiation.

canonical_statement: MRA users and non-users were matched 1:1 by greedy nearest-neighbour propensity-score matching with a caliper width of 0.1 pooled SDs using demographic, comorbidity, medication, laboratory and cardiac-function covariates.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MRA and non-MRA cohorts were matched in a 1:1 ratio based on a propensity score (PS) using the greedy nearest-neighbour algorithm with a calliper width of 0.1 pooled SDs

canonical_statement: After propensity-score matching, a standardised mean difference below 0.10 was prespecified as indicating balanced covariate distributions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: with an SMD <0.10 indicating a balanced distribution of covariates.

canonical_statement: The primary effectiveness endpoint was the composite of all-cause mortality or heart failure hospitalisation; heart failure hospitalisation was defined by administration of intravenous diuretics.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The primary effectiveness endpoint was a composite of all-cause mortality or HF hospitalisation (HFH). HFH was defined by the administration of intravenous diuretics.

canonical_statement: The safety endpoint was hyperkalaemia, defined as serum potassium at least 5.5 mEq/L.

canonical_statement: Urinary tract infection was specified as a falsification endpoint.

canonical_statement: The primary analysis used an intention-to-treat framework in which baseline MRA classification was retained regardless of subsequent treatment changes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Analyses were conducted using an intention-to-treat (ITT) framework: patients classified as MRA users or non-users at baseline remained in their assigned groups regardless of subsequent treatment changes.

canonical_statement: ATTRwt-CM and ATTRv-CM subgroup analyses were defined using ICD-10-CM coding patterns, with ATTRwt identified by E85.82 in the absence of E85.0/E85.1/E85.7 and ATTRv defined conversely.

canonical_statement: Cox proportional hazard ratios compared endpoints occurring within 2 years after the index date; Kaplan-Meier curves with log-rank tests were used for survival analyses.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that MRA use was associated with limited incremental clinical benefit in contemporary patients with ATTR-CM treated with disease-modifying therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In a contemporary cohort of patients with ATTR-CM treated with disease-modifying therapy, MRA use was associated with limited incremental clinical benefits.

canonical_statement: The authors stated that generalisation to vutrisiran-treated patients remains uncertain because the cohort was predominantly treated with tafamidis, and prospective MRA trials are needed.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Because the study population was predominantly composed of patients treated with tafamidis, whether similar findings extend to patients treated with vutrisiran requires further investigation. Our findings highlight the need for prospective trials to investigate the efficacy of MRA

canonical_statement: The retrospective observational design leaves unavoidable unmeasured confounding and limits causal inference; the authors specifically note that MRA recipients may have had more advanced heart failure despite matching.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Several limitations should be considered ... retrospective nature ... inevitable unmeasured confounding bias ... limits conclusions regarding causal inference ... it is possible that patients who were prescribed with MRA had more advanced HF

canonical_statement: Selection bias cannot be excluded because baseline characteristics of patients included in the matched cohort could not be directly compared with those excluded or unmatched during cohort construction.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We were also unable to directly compare baseline characteristics between patients included in the matched cohort and those excluded or unmatched during cohort construction. Therefore, selection bias ... cannot be fully excluded.

canonical_statement: TriNetX lacked granular echocardiographic measures such as wall thickness, diastolic function, right ventricular function and strain, limiting phenotypic characterisation and cardiac-function subgroup analyses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Second, granular echocardiographic parameters, including ventricular wall thickness, diastolic function, right ventricular function and strain imaging, were currently not available within TriNetX

canonical_statement: ATTR subtype was likely underascertained because genetic testing was not routinely performed or consistently captured, leaving residual confounding by subtype and disease severity.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: ATTR subtype was likely underascertained because genetic testing is not routinely performed or consistently captured. Therefore, residual confounding by ATTR subtype and disease severity cannot be excluded.

canonical_statement: Although eGFR and NT-proBNP were matched, individual Gillmore staging could not be incorporated into propensity matching, preventing disease-severity subgroup analysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Fourth, while Gillmore stage factors, namely eGFR and serum NT-proBNP, were well matched, we were not able to incorporate individual staging in the PS matching model.

canonical_statement: Competing-risk bias may remain for non-fatal secondary outcomes because death was not fully handled as a competing event in those analyses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Fifth ... the possibility of competing-risk bias for individual non-fatal secondary outcomes remains.

canonical_statement: Baseline ITT exposure classification could not capture adherence, duration, exact discontinuation, outside prescriptions or time-varying MRA exposure; post-index discontinuation and initiation could bias estimates toward the null.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Sixth, medication exposure was defined at baseline using an ITT framework ... unable to model MRA exposure as a time-varying variable ... postindex discontinuation ... or initiation ... may have resulted in exposure misclassification and biased estimates towards the null.

canonical_statement: The cohort may not represent patients with long-standing MRA therapy who had already demonstrated tolerance, limiting generalisability to prevalent long-term MRA users.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Seventh, our cohort may not fully represent patients with long-standing MRA therapy who had already demonstrated tolerance, limiting generalisability to prevalent long-term MRA users.

canonical_statement: Most contributing TriNetX organisations were large academic centres, which limits generalisability and motivates validation in other populations and data resources.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Lastly, patients included in the TriNetX database represent those who had medical encounters within the 70 contributing HCOs; of note, most of which are large academic centres, which also hinders the generalisability of our findings.
